description: Sven Cinematic Universe — Master Production Presets & Runbooks Catalog. Governs 1-click project initialization, automated parameter locking, model targeting, and audit thresholds for Antigravity IDE. NOTE: Aspect ratio is ALWAYS 100% user-governed and never rigidly fixed.
aspect_ratio_sovereignty_law: The aspect ratio (16:9 horizontal, 9:16 vertical, 4:3, 1:1, or 2.39:1 anamorphic) is ALWAYS governed by the user's explicit choice. Presets provide default baseline recommendations, but the Director and Screenwriter must seamlessly adapt staging to ANY aspect ratio chosen by the user.

screenplay_constraints.cadence_style: Staccato Dialogue Fencing (≤ 12 words per line)

camera_and_staging.track_a_locked_quota: Strictly 1 scene max per episode (~10%) at emotional boiling point
camera_and_staging.track_b_kinetic_quota: 80-90% dynamic cutting and kinetic camera push/whip
camera_and_staging.framing_bias: Tight Singles, Medium Close-Up (MCU), Extreme Close-Up (ECU), Low-Angle Dominance (Adapts dynamically to 9:16 vertical or 16:9 widescreen)
forbidden_optics: Wide empty establishing shots without subjects

soundscape_directives.foley_profile: Amplified micro-biomechanics, tense sharp diegetic foley, rapid breathing
